content: If the return value of Dem_J1939DcmReadDiagnosticReadiness3 is E_OK, t he return parameter ‘ DataValue’ shall be encoded into the DM26 layout according to SAE J1939 - 73. Afterwards PduR_J1939DcmTransmit with the PduId of DM26 shall be triggered and the destination address (via MetaData) set according to the source address of the request, or to 0xFF when the destination of the request was 0xFF.
